switch.title: $L_EXTERNAL_CLEAN_CACHE
switch.get: if grep "clearbox_clear_disk=1" "$work_dir/settings.prop" >/dev/null; then echo 1 else echo 0 fi
switch.set: if grep "clearbox_clear_disk=0" "$work_dir/settings.prop" >/dev/null; then sed -i 's/clearbox_clear_disk=0/clearbox_clear_disk=1/g' "$work_dir/settings.prop" echo " » $L_OPEND! " else sed -i 's/clearbox_clear_disk=1/clearbox_clear_disk=0/g' "$work_dir/settings.prop" echo " » $L_CLOSED! " fi
